stories.title: Sakana upgrades Marlin research modes and slides
stories.summary: Marlin adds Twilight 2.0 and Midnight 2.0 for faster multi-perspective analysis and broader investigation, alongside a refreshed PowerPoint export workflow.
stories.insight: Compare evidence coverage, completion time and slide usability on the same market-research brief.

stories.title: Cloudflare introduces searchable websites for agents
stories.summary: Search for Agents creates an index and a discoverable search API under a site’s domain. It is available to Cloudflare customers, including Free plans, subject to usage limits and domain controls.
stories.insight: Check retrieval for product, pricing and FAQ questions, including whether results lead back to the correct original pages.

stories.title: Gemini announces Guided Vision on iOS
stories.summary: Google announced Guided Vision in Gemini Live on iOS, offering real-time help through a shared camera. The help page describes a gradual rollout.
stories.insight: Test text reading, camera positioning feedback and latency on real packaging, menus or everyday scenes.

stories.title: fal demonstrates image generation inside Photoshop
stories.summary: fal shared a tutorial for its Agent plugin in Photoshop, showing how to generate and edit images within the creative workflow.
stories.insight: Use an actual poster to assess local edits, layer handling and preservation of brand elements.

stories.title: Gemini adds expressive voices with local accents
stories.summary: Google announced more than 60 expressive voices with local accents across the U.S., U.K., India, Indonesia, Korea and Brazil, selectable in Gemini settings.
stories.insight: Use real terminology and accent samples to assess pronunciation, listening comfort and conversational pacing.

stories.title: fal adds Microsoft MAI Image 2.7
stories.summary: fal announced availability of Microsoft’s MAI Image 2.7 and shared a narrative image-generation test on its video channel.
stories.insight: Evaluate visual storytelling with consistent character, product and scene constraints across several images.

stories.title: Together open-sources Hurdle for agent experience tests
stories.summary: Hurdle runs Claude Code and Codex against tasks involving a product’s APIs, documentation, MCPs and skills. Checks, guards and model judges score results by model and condition.
stories.insight: Turn lead research, report citations and file export into repeated tasks to identify where a workflow fails.

stories.title: Anthropic explains verification during its Rust migration
stories.summary: Anthropic shared how it migrated the Messages API from Python to Rust, using the existing service to verify behavior and Claude agents to investigate and fix differences.
stories.insight: Establish expected behavior and acceptance criteria before replacing a workflow, including edge cases users depend on.

stories.title: Adobe shares a visual-first video-planning workflow
stories.summary: Adobe highlighted Jon Youshaei’s process for evaluating video ideas and openings, including planning visual anchors in Firefly Boards before scripting.
stories.insight: Use a concise visual plan to test whether an opening communicates the central idea before committing to production.

stories.title: Vercel reduces orchestration overhead in Workflow 5.8
stories.summary: The new execution engine reduces step-to-step overhead in Vercel’s benchmarks and uses speculative execution for retryable steps.
stories.insight: Measure model time, tool time and orchestration time separately, while checking retry behavior.
